name: Human owner acceptance binds exact content and supports account-bound replay
summary: A signed-in project owner accepts exact current content in simple mode without host operator membership. A generated native decision binds immutable account/project/governance evidence and an accepted revision. Account-bound request replay returns the original result and server time without another effect, after rechecking current authority and membership; changed content refuses. Raw owner evidence remains reserved; governed mode and machine credentials gain no owner acceptance authority. Interrupted acceptance persists a validated optional owner_decision receipt binding after the native ID is confirmed and before evidence. Recovery uses that ID, never mutable discovery metadata. Missing or unreadable bound decisions and unbound legacy or lost-ID operations remain unknown. The owner may reload and accept with a fresh key, or edit a readable legacy draft and accept its new revision, without finishing the old operation. Backup/restore preserves bindings.
